* Create, draft, edit, and maintain clear and concise documentation, including User Guides, Integration Manuals, and Release Notes.
* Synthesize complex technical knowledge, collaborate with engineers, project managers, and product managers to understand product functionality and translate technical specifications into plain English.
* Maintain a consistent style and voice across all documentation, adhering to company branding and industry standards.
* Organize documentation sets in a logical flow to ensure ease of navigation and searchability.
* Gather feedback from users and support teams to identify gaps in existing documentation and proactively address them.
* Perform product research and learn domain terminology for the assigned product.
* Collaborate with the translation team on deliveries.
* Provides daily updates of your tasks/projects, and proactively escalate issues to your Lead
* Ensures tasks are completed on\-time with high quality standards
* Effectively manages multiple projects and tasks, focusing on timely implementations while adapting as priorities shift
* Understands and keep abreast of latest Medidata Products and their functionality and features
* Networks with key contacts within the delivery unit and outside their own area of expertise.
* Ensures that all relevant Medidata SOPs and WIs are followed


**Qualifications**
* Ability to read Python, C\#, SQL, and React code and translate that into plain English.
* Ability to read JSON, XML, and SAS file formats and synthesize their information into plain English.
* Ability to deep dive to understand data models, workflows and system architectures.
* Ability to explain complex topics to both technical and non\-technical audiences
* Ability to work both in different teams with widely varying skills, and independently
* Ability to create visual aids, such as diagrams, flowcharts, or screen recording to explain complex data pipelines.
* Ability to identify risks (both technical and timelines) to deliverables and raise for discussion and guidance with more senior team member
* Engage in conversations with clients, Project Managers, Engineering, Product teams and Subject Matter Experts to extract technical details.
* Results\-driven, data\-driven, entrepreneurial, and action\-oriented

* Bachelor’s degree in Technical Writing, Computer Science or Health Sciences, and a minimum of 3\-5 years of related experience, with at least 2 years specifically within Life Sciences.
* Exceptional command of grammar and style.
* Experience with GitHub’s Markdown and with “Docs\-as\-Code” workflows in GitHub.
* Experience with Jira
* Experience documenting RESTful APIs and SDKs using tools like Swagger/OpenAPI.


**What’s In It For You**
* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation .

title: Junior Frontend Developer
description:
**Role Overview:** 




 We are looking for a Junior Frontend Developer to join our engineering team. You will work closely with senior engineers and designers to build responsive, user\-facing interfaces for the product. This is a hands\-on, growth\-focused role: we expect solid fundamentals in the web platform and React, and we will help you ramp up on our project stack (Next.js) on the job. The right person is curious, takes feedback well, and wants to grow into a strong frontend engineer by shipping real features in production.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




 • Build and maintain user\-facing features in React under the guidance of senior engineers.
 



 • Translate designs and wireframes into clean, responsive UI.
 



 • Write clean, readable, and reusable code in JavaScript / TypeScript.
 



 • Integrate the frontend with backend APIs and handle application state.
 



 • Debug, fix, and test UI and integration issues across the features you work on.
 



 • Participate in code reviews and sprint ceremonies, and learn the team's conventions.
 



  





**Must\-Have (Required):** 




 • Around 1 year of frontend experience — internships, freelance, or strong personal/academic projects all count.
 



 • Solid HTML, CSS, and JavaScript fundamentals — a good grasp of the modern web platform.
 



 • Prior React experience — a working understanding of components, props, state, and hooks.
 



 • Basic understanding of responsive design and cross\-browser behaviour.
 



 • Basic understanding of how to consume REST APIs from the frontend.
 



 • Comfortable using Git for version control.
 



 • Good problem\-solving instincts, willingness to learn, and clear communication.
 



  





**Good to Have (Any of these is a plus, none required):** 




 We don't expect juniors to know our project stack on day one — we'll train you on Next.js. Any prior exposure to the below is a bonus, not a barrier:
 



 • TypeScript — any hands\-on experience.
 



 • Next.js — any exposure to routing, SSR/SSG, or server components.
 



 • State management (Redux, Zustand, or React Query).
 



 • Tailwind CSS or another modern styling approach.
 



 • Web accessibility (a11y) and performance basics.
 



 • Basic Unix/Linux command\-line comfort.
 



 • Familiarity with testing tools (e.g. Jest, React Testing Library) or project trackers (Asana, Jira, Notion).
 



  





**What This Role Is:** 




 • A genuine entry point for someone with strong fundamentals who wants to grow fast.
 



 • Mentored, with real code review and ownership of features that ship.
 



 • A clear path from Junior toward mid\-level frontend engineering.
 



  





**What This Role Is Not:** 




 • Not a role that requires prior Next.js experience.
 



 • Not a senior or solo\-ownership role — you'll work under senior guidance.

description:
**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance, who will be responsible for establishing, implementing, and maintaining quality assurance systems to ensure that manufactured tubes meet customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and internal quality standards. The role involves driving continuous improvement initiatives, managing quality audits, handling customer complaints, and ensuring compliance with quality management systems. Candidates with prior experience in the packaging industry, particularly flexible packaging, laminates, aluminum tubes, plastic tubes, or related manufacturing sectors, will be preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Quality Management
* Develop, implement, and monitor quality assurance processes across all manufacturing stages.
* Ensure compliance with Quality Management Systems (QMS) such as ISO 9001, GMP, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Establish quality standards, inspection procedures, and testing protocols for raw materials, in\-process products, and finished goods.
* Monitor product quality parameters and ensure adherence to specifications.

**Process Control \& Improvement**

* Analyze production and quality data to identify trends, defects, and improvement opportunities.
* Lead root cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions (CAPA) for quality issues.
* Implement quality improvement projects using Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Kaizen, and SPC methodologies.
* Work closely with Production, Maintenance, and R\&D teams to improve process capability and product quality.

**Customer \& Supplier Quality**

* Investigate customer complaints and ensure timely closure through effective corrective actions.
* Coordinate with customers regarding quality requirements, audits, and technical queries.
* Evaluate supplier quality performance and conduct supplier audits when required.
* Ensure incoming raw materials meet quality specifications.

**Audits \& Compliance**

* Plan and conduct internal quality audits.
* Coordinate external audits by customers, certification bodies, and regulatory agencies.
* Maintain documentation and records related to quality systems and compliance requirements.
* Ensure adherence to safety, environmental, and quality regulations.

**Team Management**

* Lead and mentor quality inspectors, laboratory staff, and quality engineers.
* Conduct training programs on quality standards, inspection techniques, and quality awareness.
* Foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

**Testing \& Laboratory Management**

* Supervise quality testing of tubes and packaging materials.
* Ensure calibration and maintenance of testing equipment.
* Review test reports and approve quality documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Polymer, Industrial, Production) or related field.
* Additional certifications in Quality Management, Six Sigma, Lead Auditor, or Quality Engineering will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* **5–8 years of experience** in Quality Assurance/Quality Control within the **Tube Manufacturing Industry**.
* **Experience in Packaging Industry is highly preferred**, including flexible packaging, laminates, plastic packaging, aluminum tubes, rigid packaging, or related sectors.
* Experience handling customer audits, quality systems, and process improvement initiatives.

**Technical Skills**

* Knowledge of ISO 9001, GMP, CAPA, SPC, FMEA, MSA, and Root Cause Analysis tools.
* Understanding of packaging materials, tube manufacturing processes, printing, lamination, extrusion, and conversion processes.
* Proficiency in quality testing instruments and laboratory practices.
* Good knowledge of ERP systems and MS Office applications.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
* Leadership and team management capabilities.
* Attention to detail and customer\-focused approach.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Customer complaint reduction.
* First Pass Yield (FPY) improvement.
* Internal and external audit compliance scores.
* Reduction in rejection, rework, and scrap levels.
* CAPA closure effectiveness.
* Supplier quality performance improvement.

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**  
A quality professional with proven experience in tube manufacturing and a strong background in the packaging industry, capable of driving quality excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations.

description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
 BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud\-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high\-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000\+ real devices and browsers.
   

  

 With over 1,200 employees and a remote\-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto\-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
   

  

 Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission\-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
   

  

**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in nutshell**
* We are looking for HR professionals, who have specialised in Human Resources (HR) to join our team as an HR Associate.
* In this role, you will gain structured exposure across multiple HR functions over a 12\-month period, enabling you to develop a strong foundation in HR and gain an understanding of the end\-to\-end employee lifecycle.
* During this period, you will work across different HR functions such as HR Operations, HR Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, and HR Centres of Excellence (CoE). This rotational exposure will provide you with hands\-on experience and a holistic view of the HR function within the organization.
* Based on your performance and organizational requirements, you will be absorbed into a specialized HR role upon successful completion of the 12\-month


**What will you do?**
 During your 12 \-month training period, you will spend time embedded within different teams, taking on active responsibilities in each:
   

  

* Talent Acquisition (TA): Learn the art and science of recruiting. You will source candidates, conduct initial screenings, manage the interview pipeline, and help build our employer brand.
* HR Business Partnering (HRBP): Understand how HR drives business goals. You will assist with employee engagement initiatives, analyze attrition and performance data, and help resolve day\-to\-day employee queries.
* Learning \& Development (L\&D): Help our people grow. You will support the onboarding of new hires, coordinate training sessions, and assist in designing content for employee upskilling programs.
* HR Operations: Master the foundations. You will get hands\-on experience with HRIS data management, compliance tracking, and the employee lifecycle processes from hire to retire.
* Secure Your Permanent Role: At the 12 \-month mark, based on your performance, natural aptitude, and business needs, you will take full ownership of a permanent position within one of these specialized functions.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Education: Recent graduate with an MB/ PGDM in Human Resources (an MBA/PGDM in HR is a strong plus).
* Work Experience: 1\-2 years of work experience in the HR field.
* Location: You must currently be based in Mumbai. While the day\-to\-day work is remote, you will need to be local for occasional team meetups and strategic planning sessions.
* Agility \& Adaptability: You thrive in a fast\-paced environment and can quickly shift gears as you transition between different HR functions and projects.
* Exceptional Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. You know how to build empathy and trust with employees, candidates, and stakeholders at all levels.
* Bias for Action: You are a motivated self\-starter. If you see a process that is broken or inefficient, you don't just report it; you proactively suggest ways to fix it.
* Tech\-Savvy: You are comfortable learning new software quickly. Familiarity with modern HR tools or Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) is a bonus.


**Benefits**
 In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
   

  

* Medical insurance for self, spouse, upto 2 dependent children and Parents or Parents\-in\-law up to INR 5,00,000
* Gratuity as per payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Unlimited Time Off to ensure our people invest in their wellbeing, to rest and rejuvenate, spend quality time with family and friends
* Remote\-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote\-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co\-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

title: Global HR Shared Services Senior Manager - C&E
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

 You will be a key member of our Global HR Shared Services Center (HRSSC), that’s redefining how we deliver world\-class HR services—scaling operational excellence, driving innovation, and enhancing the employee experience across every touchpoint. **Key Responsibilities Include**
 Improving HRSSC operations by driving initiatives looking at service quality, performance and consistency across the HRSSC hubs, ensuring delivery excellence in alignment with global priorities and stakeholder expectations.
   

  

 Design and manage performance frameworks including SLAs, KPIs, and other metrics to establish clear accountability and service quality.
   

  

 Monitor performance trends, analyze root causes, and provide data\-driven insights to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
   

  

 Maintain the HRSSC Service Catalogue and Performance Metrics Framework, ensuring alignment of new services and transitions with established operating standards.
   

  

 Foster strong working relationships with global HRSSC teams and internal stakeholders to ensure responsiveness, transparency, and proactive issue resolution.
   

  

 Identify and lead improvement initiatives to streamline operations, increase scalability, and ensure compliance across hubs.
   

  

 Support strategic execution by contributing to roadmap planning, operational reviews, and the delivery of transformation initiatives.
   

  

 Drive governance and risk management, embedding audit\-ready practices and business continuity planning into daily operations.
   

  

 Drive change and growth by leading service migrations, engaging stakeholders, implementing feedback loops and communication channels, and identifying opportunities for service expansion.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

 Strong academic foundation with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline, complemented by continuous learning and exposure to enterprise\-scale operating models.
   

  

 12\+ years of experience in HR operations and service delivery, shared services, process excellence, harmonization and governance, change management and transformation.
   

  

 Proven expertise in performance management, quality assurance, and service delivery models.
   

  

 Demonstrated success in global, matrixed environments, working effectively with senior leaders, cross\-functional partners, and geographically diverse teams. Brings deep experience leading global hubs, navigating complexity, and driving alignment across regions, cultures, and stakeholder groups—ideally within a professional services or similarly complex organization.
   

  

 Strong technology and transformation orientation, with experience leveraging HR systems and platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Workday), leading or supporting system implementations, and applying process improvement methodologies to enhance efficiency, scalability, and employee experience.
   

  

 Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies is a plus.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**What You’re Good At**
 Applying analytical thinking to interpret data, identify performance trends, and support evidence\-based decisions.
   

  

 Building strong relationships with global stakeholders by fostering trust, collaboration, and clear communication.
   

  

 Communicating complex ideas in a structured, straightforward way that enables understanding and alignment across diverse audiences.
   

  

 Improving processes by identifying inefficiencies and implementing practical, scalable solutions.
   

  

 Embedding governance practices that promote consistency, reduce risk, and ensure audit\-readiness.
   

  

 Delivering results by managing competing priorities and ensuring operational goals are met on time and to standard.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 Be part of a respected global brand that invests in its people.
   

  

 Exposure to world\-class HR systems, like Workday.
   

  

 Work in a culture that prioritizes learning, diversity, and inclusion.
   

  

 Join a growing team where your work directly drives global impact.

* Demonstrated experience in conducting Training Needs Analysis and translating findings into actionable learning strategies
* Excellent facilitation, coaching, and presentation skills with the ability to engage and motivate diverse groups

* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across all organizational levels and build strong stakeholder relationships

 Born in Vietnam with the mission “Delivering Wow, Sharing Happiness”, Pizza 4P’s has grown into one of Asia’s most loved restaurant brands — famous for house\-made cheese, artisanal pizza, and heartfelt Omotenashi hospitality. Now, its most exciting chapter yet begins in India.
 



 Pizza 4P’s India is a startup with the soul of a craft kitchen and the ambition of a movement. We are opening our first 2nd stores this year — and over the next 5 years, we will grow to 50 stores across the country, bringing our Earth\-to\-People philosophy, fresh house\-made cheese, and the magic of our handcrafted pizza ovens to one of the world’s most vibrant food cultures.
 



  





 Joining us now means building something from the ground up: shaping the culture, growing the team, and creating dining experiences India has never seen before. Every hire, every store opening, and every “wow” moment will carry your fingerprints.
 



  





**II. ROLE PURPOSE** 




 The HR Manager leads the full
 **Human Resources agenda** 
 for Pizza 4P’s India. With 2 stores launching this year and a roadmap to scale to 50 stores within 5 years, this role builds the people foundation for rapid expansion — ensuring talent readiness, workforce effectiveness, and full legal compliance from market entry through scale\-up. As the company is still at the startup stage, this is a hands\-on role: the HR Manager personally executes alongside setting strategy — from screening candidates and running payroll to onboarding the very first store teams — until the function scales.
 



  





**Reporting to:** 
 Country Manager – India
 



**Functional reporting line to** 
 : Global People \& Culture Division
 



**Scope:** 
 Corporate office, all store locations, and the cheese factory across India (currently 2 stores in Bangalore, expanding to 50 nationwide)
 



  





**III. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** 




**HR Management \& Workforce Effectiveness** 



* Develop and implement HR strategies aligned with business priorities and growth plans
* Lead onboarding, training, engagement, and retention initiatives
* Oversee performance management and appraisal systems
* Manage employee relations, disciplinary cases, and investigations
* Ensure payroll accuracy, timeliness, and full compliance with Indian labor laws (PF, ESI, gratuity, state Shops \& Establishments Acts, POSH) and company policies
* Align Compensation \& Benefits practices with local market standards
* Maintain HR records and prepare required HR reports
* Lead the development and maintenance of local HR policies (accommodation, travel, leave, disciplinary) in line with Indian labor laws
* Oversee the partner accommodation program, including policy, eligibility, and cost management
* Manage the end\-to\-end offboarding process, including exit interviews, settlements, and documentation
* Oversee attendance and leave administration, probation reviews, and monthly promotion and increment processes
* Monitor changes in labor regulations (e.g., minimum wage revisions) and proactively update company practices
* Support expatriate partners with relocation, documentation, and administrative setup
* Maintain accurate and reliable HR data across systems and drive digitalization of HR operations



**Talent Management** 



* Lead end\-to\-end talent acquisition, including workforce planning, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management for both corporate and store positions
* Build a repeatable new\-store hiring playbook (staffing model, hiring timelines, and training handover per store) to support the expansion from 2 to 50 stores within 5 years
* Develop internal promotion pathways and a Store Manager / Pizzaiolo leadership pipeline so each new store can be led by home\-grown talent
* Identify high\-potential employees and create individual development plans (training, coaching, cross\-store exposure) to accelerate their readiness for bigger roles
* Maintain succession plans for key roles (Store Manager, Head Chef / Pizzaiolo, corporate leads) so every planned store opening has identified successors in advance
* Build proactive talent pipelines (hospitality institutes, culinary schools, referral programs) and establish Pizza 4P’s employer brand in the Indian F\&B market
* Manage recruitment channels, agencies, and job portals; track and improve hiring metrics such as time\-to\-fill, cost\-per\-hire, and quality of hire
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and ensure a positive, consistent candidate experience aligned with Omotenashi values
* Maintain continuous hiring for existing stores to ensure full staffing alongside new\-store expansion



**Communication \& Coordination** 



* Act as the key contact point for employees, vendors, partners, and stakeholders
* Coordinate closely with Global People \& Culture Team to ensure alignment
* Support cross\-functional collaboration across HR, Operations, and other departments



**Additional Responsibilities** 



* Support company events, meetings, and internal activities
* Handle ad\-hoc tasks and projects assigned by the Country Manager
* Identify opportunities for process improvement and operational efficiency



  





**Culture \& Engagement** 



* Localize and roll out 4P's culture programs and values activation initiatives across India
* Develop and run partner recognition programs aligned with 4P's values
* Drive engagement improvement through action plans based on partner survey insights
* Plan and deliver company events and internal culture activities








**IV. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




**Experience \& Qualifications** 



* Proven experience as an HR Manager, HR Business Partner, or similar role
* Background in retail, F\&B, or restaurant operations preferred; experience scaling teams through rapid multi\-site expansion is a strong advantage
* Strong knowledge of recruitment, performance management, and employee relations
* Strong knowledge of Indian labor regulations (PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops \& Establishments Acts, POSH) and HR best practices; multi\-state compliance experience a plus
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills
* Hands\-on, roll\-up\-your\-sleeves working style — comfortable personally executing day\-to\-day HR tasks without a support team, as expected in a startup environment



  





**Disclaimer** 




 This Job Profile is intended as a reference framework. Actual responsibilities, scope, and requirements may be adjusted based on business priorities and evolving organizational needs.

description:
**About Affinity** 




  





 Affinity is pioneering new frontiers in AdTech; developing solutions that push past today’s limits and open new opportunities. We are a global AdTech company helping publishers discover better ways to monetize and enabling advertisers to reach the right audiences through new touch\-points. Operating across 10\+ markets in Asia, the US, and Europe with a team of over 450 experts, we are building privacy\-first ad infrastructure that opens opportunities beyond the walled gardens.
 



  





**About the role** 




  





 To design and deliver an exceptional early life journey from the point of offer acceptance to
 



 confirmation, establishing a strong sense of belonging, culture alignment, and engagement. The
 



 role also plays a key part in building Affinity Global’s employer brand and employee advocacy
 



 through internal programs and external platforms.
 



  





**Stakeholder Group \& Span** 




  





 This role serves as the first true touchpoint of the Affinity experience for new hires and is a vital
 



 link between Talent Acquisition and HRBPs. It covers the pre\-onboarding, onboarding, induction,
 



 and early engagement phase while also shaping how the employer brand is perceived by the
 



 market.
 



  





**Core Responsibilities** 




  





**Pre\-Joining \& Offer\-to\-Join Experience** 




  





 • Manage soft handovers from Talent Acquisition once offers are accepted
 



 • Design structured pre\-joining communication journeys (emails, calls, nudges)
 



 • Build a dashboard to track drop\-off risks and early signals of disengagement
 



 • Manage buddy assignments, welcome kits, and readiness protocols
 



  





**Onboarding \& Induction** 




  





 • Own the India onboarding process end\-to\-end including scheduling, delivery, and
 



 feedback
 



 • Partner with HR Ops and Admin to ensure smooth joining, documentation, ID cards etc
 



 • Own the Day 0 experience, design, present, and refine the induction deck
 



 • Lead post\-induction survey rollout, extract insights, and lead improvements
 



 • Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure system, seat allocation, IT, and cultural readiness
 



  





**Engagement During First 90 Days** 




  





 • Anchor engagement surveys at 30, 60, and 90 days, analytics, action planning, and
 



 presentation to leadership
 



 • Collaborate with HRBPs to identify and action any friction points during the early lifecycle
 



 • Ensure smooth handoff to respective HRBP post\-confirmation
 



  





**Culture \& Experience Programs** 




  





 • Plan, publish, and execute quarterly engagement calendar for all India teams
 



 • Drive R\&R programs, birthday celebrations and other events within defined budgets
 



 • Co\-own Annual Offsite planning and execution (in partnership with HR Ops \& Finance)
 



 • Lead idea generation and partner with cross\-teams for engagement initiatives
 



 • Own the feedback mechanism, loop and publish impact in quarterly/half yearly reports
 



  





**Employer Brand \& External Perception** 




  





 • Affinity’s Voice: Manage \& respond to reviews on Glassdoor and Ambition Box.
 



 • Drive proactive reputation\-building by encouraging reviews from satisfied employees at
 



 key milestones (90 days, employee engagement, anniversaries etc.)
 



 • Coordinate with Marketing to support Employer Branding initiatives \& storylines
 



 • Contribute content and data points for posts about culture, DEI, events \& team highlights
 



  





**WeWork Relationship Management** 




  





 • Serve as HR’s liaison for non\-commercial engagement with WeWork
 



 • Manage seat planning, allocations, and feedback for joiners in coordination with HRBPs
 



  





**Key Success Metrics** 




  





 • Offer\-to\-Join Ratio (\>90%)
 



 • 90\-Day Attrition Tracking and Reduction
 



 • Onboarding Satisfaction Score (Survey\-based)
 



 • Completion Rate of 30/60/90 Day Surveys \& Feedback Loops
 



 • Monthly Engagement Event Delivery vs Plan
 



 • Budget Utilization
 



 • Annual Offsite Feedback \& Execution Rating
 



  





**Key Requirements** 




  





 •
 **Currently managing HC of 500\+ in a HR Manager/ Employee Exp Manager capacity** 




 • 8\+ Years in Employee Experience \& Employee Engagement Roles
 



 • Experience in Managing C\-suite Stakeholders
 



 • Ability to work in a fast paced large HR team (20\+ Team members)
 



 • Ability to plan \& organise Employee Events and Engagement Activities
 



 • Experience within large
 **Tech, Ad\-tech, Fintech or SaaS tech is essential**

title: Senior Manager, Employee Relations (Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided)
description:
**About Agoda**
 At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
   

  

 Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
   

  

 No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
   

  

**Get To Know Our Team:**
 The People Team is a purveyor of opportunity, searching the globe for the most talented individuals and offering them an open, collaborative workplace. By prioritizing skill and potential, we have cultivated a powerful assembly of professionals through our drive for equal opportunity and diversity. We make the move to Agoda a breeze with assisted onboarding programs, and we continue to support and enrich our thousands of Agoda employees through individual growth with outstanding learning programs and various means of assistance. Our development of incredible benefits has ensured everyone can stay strong, healthy, and happy during their time at Agoda. Leading ambitious changes and making a positive impact in the lives of our employees, the People Team is a crucial and rewarding part of the Agoda family.
   

  

**The Opportunity:**
 We are looking for someone to lead our Global Employee Relations Team as a Senior Manager, Employee Relations. This role leads the development of policies, advisory standards, case governance and analytics to ensure fair, consistent and legally sound people practices. The incumbent partners closely with HR leadership, Legal, unions, and government agencies to manage complex disciplinary matters, labor relations issues and emerging workforce risks.
   

  

 The role combines deep industrial relationships expertise, policy leadership, stakeholder influence, and data\-driven decision making, and serves as a subject\-matter authority on employment legislation and industrial relations strategy.
   

  

 Our Employee Relations consultants work closely with key stakeholders including our Legal/Compliance team, Corporate Tax, Corporate Governance, Talent Business Partner team and the Senior Management Team to support employees in challenging circumstances, and we seek to identify trends and share insights to adjust our people management practices to get the best talent outcomes. We advise and enable managers to make the best possible decisions, challenging practices that go beyond legal obligation to protect our unique culture at Agoda.
   

  

**What You’ll Do:**
* Elevate Compliance and Policy Expertise: Act as the go\-to specialist on ER Matters, guiding managers in adhering to company policies, local laws, and regulations. Establish governance standards, operating guidelines and decision frameworks to ensure consistency across the organization. Translate employment legislation, case law and regulatory changes into clear institutional policies and guidance.
* Enhance Manager Effectiveness: Lead the design, review and implementation and advise people managers on the Organization\-wide employee \& labor relations and HR policy framework. Critically evaluate systemic issues in manager capability and practices and escalate them appropriately to business leaders for sustainable resolution.
* Union Engagement: Represent the organization in union consultations, negotiations, arbitration and dispute resolution forums. Analyze union and management proposals to assess policy, financial and employee\-relations implications. Support collective bargaining strategies through data, benchmarking and scenario analysis.
* Streamline Disciplinary and Termination Processes: Ensure accurate execution and documentation of disciplinary actions and terminations to minimize labor disputes.
* Lead Investigations and Employee Relations processes: Conduct impartial investigations into grievances and serve as a dedicated Employee Relations partner, identifying trends and insights to inform procedural improvements.
* Drive Performance and Policy Enhancements through Analytics: Analyze performance management data and past misconduct cases to develop recommendations for capability\-building, policy revisions, training enhancements, and more effective management practices.
* Optimize Performance Management and Offboarding: Spearhead improvements in performance management systems and refine offboarding processes, incorporating data from different sources to enhance employee experiences.
* Regulatory \& Dispute Management: Liaise with Legal team to represent and manage the Company in negotiations, arbitrations and dispute resolution forums or other regulatory authorities.


**Required Qualifications:**
* Deep understanding of employee relations, labor relations and workplace dispute management.
* Strong working knowledge of employment legislation, regulations and industrial relations practices.
* Ability to interpret legislation and apply it practically within complex organizational environments.
* Advanced stakeholder management and influencing capability across senior leaders, unions and regulators.
* Strong negotiation, mediation and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Ability to balance organizational risk with empathy and sound judgement.
* Degree in Human Resource Management, Law, Industrial Relations, or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* A minimum of 13 years in Employee and Labor Relations or HR Business Partnering roles within large or regulated organizations, with a proven track record of handling complex employee relations issues.
* Extensive knowledge of employment laws and regulations in the relevant region, with the ability to interpret and apply them in various scenarios.
* Hands\-on experience managing and executing restructuring/change management projects
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders
* Ability to cope well with ambiguity and change
* High level of discretion, confidentiality, and ethical standards in handling sensitive information and situations.
* Sound judgment and the ability to make well\-informed decisions, balancing legal compliance with business needs.
* Proficiency in using data and analytics to inform decision\-making processes and improve employee relations strategies.
* Fluency in written and spoken English, with strong communication skills to effectively convey complex information.
* Demonstrated leadership qualities and a desire to take on managerial responsibilities in the future.


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Curiosity, ready to challenge current practices and perspectives
* Great attention to detail
* Great sense of ownership and reliability
* Multicultural or International Experience
* Humility, flexibility, good interpersonal skills


 \#Singapore \#London \#HongKong \#Berlin \#Paris \#Tokyo \#Shanghai \#Beijing \#Sydney \#KualaLumpur \#Bangkok \#Seoul \#Amsterdam \#Dublin \#Barcelona \#Madrid \#Warsaw \#Prague \#Budapest \#Dubai \#Bangalore \#Mumbai \#Gurgaon \#Delhi \#Jakarta \#Manila \#Taipei \#Shenzhen \#Munich \#Zurich

**Job Description**

 The Learning \& Development Manager – Soft Skills will be responsible for designing, implementing, and continuously improving global training programs that enhance the soft skills of managers and experts within the Operations department. This role will ensure alignment with organizational goals and stakeholder expectations, driving talent development and fostering a culture of continuous learning across multiple hubs. The L\&D manager in this role will manage the work of a team of Soft Skills trainers and collaborate with stakeholders across regions and functions to drive a culture of learning and continuous improvement. Key stakeholders for this role include Operations Leaders and Hub Leaders, Human Resources, Global Learning Team.
   

  





**RESPONSIBILITIES:**




 Training \& Talent Program Management:
   

  





 · Organize, maintain, and continuously improve Training \& Development programs for managers and experts within the Operations department globally.
   

  





 · Define soft skills training needs in alignment with key stakeholders, including Hub Leaders, to address current and future competency gaps.
   

  





 · Design and execute Hi\-Potential \& Talent training programs for the Operations department globally, with a special focus on five strategic hubs.
   

  





 Soft Skills Training
   

  





 · Plan, organize, and report on soft skills training sessions for Operations teams globally, ensuring timely execution and measurable outcomes.
   

  





 · Deliver Soft Skills training sessions as necessary.
   

  





 · Manage training content for soft skills learning modules within the in\-house learning platform, ensuring relevance and quality.
   

  





 · Manage Workday reporting and administrative tasks related to organization and completion tracking of Soft Skills trainings.
   

  





 Team Leadership
   

  





 · Manage and develop a global team of Soft Skills trainers based in multiple locations, providing guidance, coaching, and performance feedback.
   

  





 · Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  





 · Coordinate and collaborate with a distributed team of soft skills trainers across Operations hubs to ensure consistency and excellence in delivery.
   

  





 Continuous Improvement
   

  





 · Analyze learning metrics and feedback to identify opportunities for improvement.
   

  





 · Implement innovative learning solutions and best practices to enhance employee development.

* Collaborative mindset with global perspective

It takes an Omni Channel approach to diversify online and offline channels and optimizes sales strategies for expansion and growth.  We are looking for a proactive and experienced Senior Lead – Human Resources to oversee and drive the organization's HR function. title: Manager, Human Resources Business Consultant
description:
Serves as a strategic Human Resources partner for aligned business areas. Leads a team focused on enabling business solutions through effective HR programs and policies. Partners with business areas of medium size and complexity.
   

  

**About Vanguard**
 Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
   

  

******Vanguard’s India Office******
 Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud\-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world\-class experience for our clients.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Manages and oversees crew relations cases of medium complexity. Mentors and provide coaching to crew and leaders. Recommends solutions to senior management on business strategy and its effects on crew.
* Advocates for the HR agenda with senior business leaders. Aligns the business with global HR policies and programs. Conducts workforce planning activities within aligned business areas.
* Consults with aligned business areas to develop HR strategies that support the needs of the business. Implements HR initiatives within the business area and acts as a liaison to other human resources functions. Manages and develops initiatives that align with the development of HR strategy.
* Provides guidance on diversity, inclusion, and engagement topics. Partners with other Human Resources specialists to strategize and implement the best outcomes for the assigned business areas and Vanguard at large.
* Makes recommendations and provides improvement insight regarding program goals and objectives in all areas of Human Resources management. Delivers reports to the business on key HR trends and metrics.
* Participates in special projects and performs other duties as assigned.


**Qualifications**
* 8\-10 years related work experience, 5 years consulting and delivering internal communications experience preferred.
* Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and experience. Graduate degree preferred.


******Location******
 This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard’s India office. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
   

  

******Our mission******
 Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
   

  

******Our commitment to you******
 Vanguard takes the same long\-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
   

  

******Financial wellness******
 We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
   

  

******Physical wellness******
 We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
   

  

******Personal wellness******
 We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
   

  

******How we work******
 Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in\-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission\-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long\-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Recruiting Coordinator
description:
**Who Are We?**
 Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million\+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500\. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API\-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.
   

  

 The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore \- where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.
   

  

 P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API\-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Recruiting Operations Coordinator is the operational backbone of Postman's recruiting function. In this role, you will ensure that every search runs smoothly from open to close — keeping interviews scheduled, data clean, feedback flowing, and candidates well\-informed throughout their experience. This is an ideal role for someone early in their career who is organized, detail\-oriented, and excited to build foundational expertise in talent acquisition at a fast\-growing technology company. You will work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates, and will play a direct role in how Postman is perceived as an employer.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
*Interview Coordination*
* Own end\-to\-end interview scheduling across all active roles, coordinating availability between candidates, interviewers, and hiring managers with a high degree of accuracy and responsiveness
* Send timely confirmations, reminders, and logistical details to all interview participants
* Manage reschedules and last\-minute changes with professionalism and minimal disruption to the process
* Proactively identify and solve scheduling or process bottlenecks, continuously improving recruiting workflows and coordination processes


*Data Integrity \& ATS Hygiene*
* Audit active job requisitions to ensure all required fields are complete and accurate in the ATS — including job details, compensation bands, stage statuses, and interviewer assignments
* Flag and resolve data gaps in collaboration with recruiters before they affect reporting
* Ensure every closed role has a complete and accurate record before it is archived


*Feedback \& Interview Completion*
* Monitor interview completion rates and follow up with interviewers to ensure feedback is submitted within expected SLAs
* Track which interviews have been recorded and flag any gaps to the relevant recruiter
* Maintain a real\-time view of where feedback is outstanding across all active searches


*Candidate Experience \& Surveys*
* Deliver a high\-touch, candidate\-first experience across every stage of the interview process
* Coordinate the distribution of candidate experience surveys at key touchpoints in the process
* Track response rates and flag low engagement to the recruiting team
* Compile survey results on a regular cadence and summarize key themes for review


*Employer Brand Monitoring*
* Monitor Glassdoor, LinkedIn, Blind, and other relevant platforms for new candidate and employee reviews related to the recruiting and interview experience
* Surface notable feedback to the recruiting team on a regular basis
* Help maintain the accuracy of Postman's employer profiles across platforms


*Metrics \& Reporting*
* Collect and organize data on completed roles, including time to fill, source, offer acceptance, and interview\-to\-offer ratios
* Prepare regular metric summaries for the Head of Recruiting
* Support the team in ensuring data is ready and accurate for monthly and quarterly reporting cycles


**About You**
 You are someone who takes genuine pride in keeping things running well. You notice when something is missing before anyone else does, and you follow through without needing to be reminded. You are comfortable working across multiple workstreams simultaneously and can shift priorities calmly when something urgent comes up.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; coursework or internship experience in HR, business, communications, or operations is a plus but not required
* 0–1 years of professional experience; strong internship or project\-based experience is equally valued
* Exceptional attention to detail — you catch the things others miss
* Strong written communication skills; you can write a clear, professional message to a candidate or a senior hiring manager with equal ease
* Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and calendar management; experience with an ATS (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday) is a bonus
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style — you understand that your work makes everyone around you more effective
* Curiosity about how recruiting works as a function and interest in growing within talent acquisition or HR operations over time
* Thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment while managing multiple priorities with strong ownership and attention to detail


**What Else?**
 In addition to Postman's pay\-on\-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team\-building events will keep you connected, while our donation\-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long\-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.
   

  

 At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in\-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.
   

  

**Equal opportunity**
 Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

description:

Innovation and creativity are built into the DNA of the company and are encouraged at all levels of employment.  Job Title: L\&D Trainer
   

  

 Location: JPX1
   

  

**Summary**
 We are looking for a Trainer who is committed to supporting our rapidly growing Learning \& Development initiatives across the 3P network within our Fulfillment Center operations. The ideal candidate brings hands\-on experience in delivering regional training, monitoring associate development and learning readiness across multiple sites.
   

  

 They should be well\-versed in learning needs identification, content improvement, and designing solutions that drive skill building and quality performance.  Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Training \& Development**
 Deliver comprehensive training across all FC operations including receiving, stowing, picking, packing, and shipping
   

  

 Train associates on equipment operation including radio frequency scanners, forklifts, pallet jacks, and walkie\-riders
   

  

 Maintain expertise in all production processes to provide effective, real\-world training
   

  

 Stay current with latest techniques, tools, and operational processes
   

  

**Operational Execution**
 Perform all warehouse functions as needed, including picking orders on multi\-level mezzanines, packing and shipping customer orders, and troubleshooting operational issues
   

  

 Operate material handling equipment safely and efficiently
   

  

 Adapt flexibly to various roles across the fulfillment center based on operational needs
   

  

 Adhere to strict safety, quality, and production standards across all shifts
   

  

**Leadership \& Support**
 Lead by example, demonstrating best practices and expected behaviors
   

  

 Listen actively to associates and provide support to management teams
   

  

 Maintain approachability and engage with employees to identify learning and development opportunities
   

  

 Respond promptly to requests and follow through on commitments
   

  

 Accept accountability, acknowledge mistakes, and continuously push personal limits
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Conduct pre\-shift safety briefings and training sessions across Receive, Stow, Pick, Pack, and Ship process paths. Perform quality audits, provide real\-time coaching, and operate material handling equipment while demonstrating proper techniques. Support production operations during peak periods, troubleshoot issues, and complete training documentation. Adapt to labor transfers on daily or weekly basis per business requirements.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience using Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience using using the Training Needs Analysis process, including assessing performance gaps, analyzing learning needs, designing and developing customer\-centric solutions, and evaluating the effectiveness of learning programs

title: Business Analyst(India/Remote)
description:
India(Remote)
  
#### **About the Role**


We're a Webflow design and development agency serving B2B and SaaS clients. Our delivery stack runs on a no\-code foundation — Webflow, Airtable, Softr, Xano, Memberstack, n8n — and we're increasingly layering AI into everything we do, with Claude as our primary tool.


We're hiring someone who blends Business Analyst and Product Manager DNA — sitting at the intersection of strategy, design, and engineering. You'll take vague client problems and drive them through discovery, wireframing, documentation, build coordination, and launch. On the PM side, you'll think in roadmaps, prioritize ruthlessly, define what success looks like, and own outcomes — not just outputs. This applies to both client projects and our own internal products.


This is a customer\-facing role. You'll own the full arc of client projects and contribute to the direction of the products we build ourselves. This is not a role for someone learning the ropes. We need 3\+ years of real BA, PM, or equivalent experience — you've scoped projects, written PRDs and SRS documents, run UAT, prioritized backlogs, handled stakeholders, and shipped things that went live.

#### **What You'll Do**

##### ***Discovery \& Client Strategy***

* Run discovery calls with clients. Translate business problems into clear scope, constraints, and dependencies.
* Write approach documents, SRS, formal proposals, and budget reports.
* Own stakeholder engagement and solution evaluation end\-to\-end.
* Bid on RFPs — craft well\-scoped, compelling responses.

##### ***Product Management***

* Own product strategy and roadmap for both client builds and our internal products.
* Write PRDs, define MVP scope, and prioritize features against business goals — not just feature requests.
* Define success metrics for what you ship and follow up to see if they were hit.
* Run customer feedback loops: synthesize user interviews, support tickets, analytics into clear product decisions.
* Maintain backlogs. Run sprint planning. Make hard calls on what doesn't get built.
* Conduct competitive analysis and market research to inform positioning and feature decisions.

##### ***Design \& UX***

* Sketch UX wireframes for Webflow designs and internal tool builds.
* Drive user\-centred design (UCD): user research, personas, user flows, journey maps, information architecture.
* Prototype in Figma, Whimsical, Miro — whatever gets the idea across fastest.
* Run user testing before shipping.

##### ***Documentation \& Delivery***

* Write user stories, flow charts, and UML diagrams that the dev team can build from without needing clarification.
* Coordinate with developers to ensure specs are understood and the build matches the intent.
* Run UAT. Maintain BA artefacts. Keep project documentation accurate and current.

##### ***Systems \& AI***

* Use Claude daily as a working collaborator — for drafting specs, generating user stories, analyzing feedback, writing proposals, and automating repetitive work.
* Design and build internal systems: Airtable bases, Claude\-powered workflows (MCP, Claude in Chrome, Cowork, Claude Code), automation pipelines that connect our stack.
* Treat repetitive tasks as automation candidates. If you did it twice, the third time should be a system.
* Research emerging no\-code and AI tools, pilot the ones that matter, drop the ones that don't.

#### **What You Bring**

#### **Required**

* **3\+ years of experience** as a Business Analyst, Product Manager, Solutions Architect, or equivalent role. Freshers will not be considered.
* **Product thinking.** You've owned a product or feature end\-to\-end — not just gathered requirements. You can defend why something should or shouldn't ship, and you measure outcomes after launch.
* **Communication: 8/10 or better.** This role is customer\-facing. You write clean emails, run discovery calls without rambling, and explain technical tradeoffs to non\-technical founders.
* **Hands\-on experience with Claude or similar AI tools.** Not surface\-level use — you've built workflows, used Projects, and ideally touched MCP, Claude Code, or comparable agent tooling. If you can't show us how you've used AI to actually do work, this isn't the role for you.
* **Systems thinking.** You see patterns, build repeatable processes, and document what you figure out.
* **No\-code fluency.** Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of: Webflow, Airtable, Softr, Xano, Memberstack, n8n, Zapier, Figma.
* **UX fundamentals.** You can wireframe. You understand IA, user flows, UCD. You've shipped real products.
* **Documentation discipline.** PRDs, user stories, SRS, approach docs, proposals — writing is a core deliverable, not an afterthought.

#### **Preferred**

* Prior experience as a PM at a SaaS company or as a BA/PM at a digital agency.
* Experience bidding on and winning RFPs.
* Background with SaaS or B2B clients.
* Familiarity with SEO, analytics (GA4, GSC), or growth tooling.

#### **How You'll Know You're a Fit**

* You read a client brief and your first instinct is "what's the cleanest system to solve this."
* You'd rather spend an afternoon teaching Claude to do a task than doing it manually 20 times.
* You enjoy both the strategy (why are we building this?) and the detail (why is this button on the left?).
* You work well asynchronously, write clearly, and don't need to be chased for updates.

#### **Logistics**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years
* **Shift:** 7:00 PM – 4:00 AM IST (US overlap hours)
* **Location:** Remote, India\-based

**Position Summary:**

Success in this role requires strong collaboration, efficiency under pressure, and a proactive, positive attitude.

**Experience**

* Demonstrated interest in slot machines, casino games, and/or game design—through professional experience, academic work, personal projects, or hobbyist game design (slots, table games such as blackjack, poker, baccarat, etc.) is preferred.

**Education**
* Master’s degree required in Mathematics, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Ph.D. in related field is plus.
* Coursework or projects with a strong focus on probability, statistics, or combinatorics are strongly preferred.


**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities**
* Strong applied math skills with the ability to build, analyze, and balance stochastic models (e.g., RTP, hit frequency, volatility, bonus frequencies).
* Able to independently develop, evaluate, and iterate on new mathematical game concepts that align with player experience and product goals.
* Regularly contributes creative ideas and mechanics to game design discussions; comfortable collaborating with designers, artists, and producers and explaining math clearly to non\-mathematicians.
* Proficiency with analytical and development tools, including:
* Strong Excel or similar spreadsheet skills for building and tuning math models.
* Experience with at least one programming or scripting environment for simulation and analysis (e.g. C\#, C\+\+, Python); C\+\+ is a strong plus.
* Detail\-oriented and comfortable with iterative work enjoys tuning parameters, validating results, and rigorously testing math models.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; able to document math clearly and support math reviews with other teams.

 Headquartered in India, its flagship product, the PhonePe digital payments app, was launched in Aug 2016\. As of April 2025, PhonePe has over 60 Crore (600 Million) registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4 Crore (40\+ million) merchants. PhonePe also processes over 33 Crore (330\+ Million) transactions daily with an Annualized Total Payment Value (TPV) of over INR 150 lakh crore.

We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe\-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

We collaborate with other SRE teams to build various infrastructure services and carry out routine production management activities, including infrastructure scaling, database maintenance, and operating system vulnerability rollouts etc.

 As an Service Delivery Engineer, you will be part of a team responsible for building, managing, and scaling the production systems of PhonePe to ensure uninterrupted services to users across the country. You will primarily work on well\-defined tasks under supervision and by following predefined SOPs.

* Deploy operating system vulnerability fixes to production systems.

* Understand the criticality of production infrastructure.

**Knowledge of the following will be a plus**
* MariaDB or similar Distributed Database Systems
* Docker or similar Containerization technology
* Nginx or similar Proxy technology
* GIT
* Basic Networking Concepts
* Linux\-based Firewall
* Basic understanding of HTTP \& TLS Security
* Ability to write Python based scripts for various automations


 Softskills:
   

  

* Good Interpersonal Communication Skills
* Ability to understand \& follow SOPs


 Qualifications:
   

  

* Minimum of 1\-3 years of hands\-on experience in Linux / Unix System Administration.


 Work Location: Bangalore
   

  

 Note: This role requires the candidate to be available for on\-call shifts on a rotational basis, covering 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

title: Site Reliability Engineering
description:
**About Innovapptive** 




  





 Innovapptive is an enterprise SaaS company building an AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform for industrial organizations. Our platform connects frontline workers, back\-office systems, and assets in real\-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity.Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly\-Clark, Scott Miracle\-Gro, and Newmont Mining, rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations.
 



 Our customers have achieved $50M\+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10× improvement in frontline productivity, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs. Innovapptive is recognized as a Leader in Frost \& Sullivan's “Frost Radar 2025 \- Augmented Connected Worker Platforms”, with acknowledgments from Gartner and LNS Research, and is backed by Vista Equity Partners and Tiger Global Management. With headquarters in Houston and an engineering center in Hyderabad, we have 300\+ employees across the U.S., India, and ANZ and are on a strong trajectory toward $100M ARR.
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Innovapptive is a premier enterprise SaaS provider building an AI\-powered Connected Worker Platform for industrial giants like Shell and Hess. As an industry leader scaling rapidly toward $100M ARR, our engineering ecosystem connects frontline workers with mission\-critical systems like SAP and Maximo in real time. Our lean SaaSOps team currently manages 45 cloud environments at an intense 11:1 ratio per engineer, making world\-class infrastructure reliability our top priority. To support our explosive commercial growth, we are expanding our P\&I Engineering division to scale our infrastructure seamlessly to over 100 environments.
 



 We are seeking a high\-caliber Site Reliability Engineer (Band A2\) in Hyderabad to absorb this operational load by embedding a culture of relentless automation. In this high\-impact role, you will own the stability, elasticity, and deployment safety of our AWS\-driven, Kubernetes\-orchestrated (EKS) multi\-tenant infrastructure. You will champion infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) using Terraform, guard 5 monthly release trains via canary and rollback pipelines, and proactively introduce Chaos Engineering. Operating under a mature, metrics\-driven framework, you will directly eliminate manual toil, document critical procedures, and participate in a responsive on\-call rotation. This position offers a highly transparent career trajectory to Senior SRE, reporting to a leadership team actively evolving into a world\-class VP\-led SRE pillar.
 



  





**What You Own** 




 Your responsibilities bridge the gap between software development and system operations, focusing heavily on automation and resilience.
 



 ● Cloud \& Environment Infrastructure: Manage and scale environments across AWS services, specifically handling Kubernetes clusters via Amazon EKS, databases (RDS, DynamoDB), and content delivery (CloudFront, S3\).
 



 ● Deployment Operations: Support 5 major release trains every month. You will handle canary deployments, rollbacks, and run Chaos Engineering exercises to test system resilience.
 



 ● CI/CD \& Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Use Terraform and Helm to provision infrastructure automatically, and maintain deployment pipelines using GitLab CI/Jenkins and ArgoCD.
 



 ● Monitoring \& Reliability: Set up SLIs/SLOs (Service Level Indicators/Objectives), design dashboards, and manage alerting using Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and ELK.
 



 ● Incident Response: Participate in the team's on\-call rotation, drive Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and write post\-mortems to ensure the same issue doesn't happen twice.
 



  





**You Must Have** 




 ● 3\-5 years in SRE, DevOps, or infrastructure.
 



 ● AWS: EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, VPC,Dynamodb,Lambda
 



 ● IaC : Terraform,Helm
 



 ● Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
 



 ● CI/CD: GitLab CI or Jenkins,ArgoCD
 



 ● Strong scripting with Bash and/or Python.
 



 ● Linux admin.
 



 ● Monitoring: CloudWatch, Grafana, ELK, Prometheus
 



  





**Nice to Have** 




 ● MongoDB operations.
 



 ● RabbitMQ operations.
 



 ● Multi\-tenant SaaS.
 



 ● AWS certifications.
 



  





**You Will Be Measured On** 




 Unlike some vague roles, Innovapptive has very specific, quantifiable metrics for this position:
 



 ● Speed: Provisioning new environments strictly within the agreed SLA.
 



 ● Reliability: Achieving zero deployment failures caused by underlying infrastructure issues.
 



 ● Efficiency: Successfully automating at least 1 manual process every month.
 



 ● Responsiveness: Acknowledging critical on\-call alerts within 15 minutes.
 



 ● Knowledge Sharing: Ensuring 100% of critical operational procedures are fully documented in runbooks.
 



  





**Tech Stack \& Tools** 




 ● Cloud: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, CloudFront, IAM, VPC, Route53\)
 



 ● Containers: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), Helm
 



 ● CI/CD: GitLab CI, Jenkins
 



 ● IaC: Terraform, Ansible
 



 ● Monitoring: CloudWatch, Grafana, Sentry
 



 ● Databases: MongoDB, Redis
 



 ● Messaging: RabbitMQ
 



  





**What We Offer** 




 ● A positive, open, and highly\-innovative environment and team
 



 ● Entrepreneurial spirit with unlimited opportunity to grow
 



 ● Opportunity to work with leading global brands on exciting and impactful projects
 



 ● Competitive Base Pay
 



 ● Best of plan on Vacation \& Paid Time Off.
 



 ● Provision of Medical Insurance for family \- self, dependent, spouse, dependent children, parents/parent\-in\-laws
 



 ● Paid Maternity and Paternity leave
 



 ● Bi\-annual reviews to ensure transparency and promoting high performance culture
 



 ● OKR Driven Performance Development Environment
 



 ● Learning \& Development \- access to wide range of e\-Learning courses (technical, Product, Process, etc.,)
